beats.say: Here is our equation. 4 x, minus 11, equals 5. Somewhere behind that x a number is hiding, and we are going to find it.
Think of the equals sign as a balance. Whatever we do to one side, we do to the other. So, what is in the way of the 4 x?

ask.ifNot: Look at the left side once more. The 4 x has a minus 11 hanging on to it. That is the first thing to clear away.

beats.say: To undo minus 11, we add 11. And to keep the balance level, we add it to both sides.
On the left, minus 11 and plus 11 cancel each other out. On the right, 5 plus 11 makes 16.
Nearly there. 4 x means 4 times x. What undoes times 4?

ask.ifNot: Times and divide are partners. Whatever times does, divide undoes. So to undo times 4, we divide by 4.

beats.say: So we divide both sides by 4.
16 divided by 4 is 4. So x equals 4. There is our hidden number!
Good mathematicians always check. Put 4 back in place of x. 4 times 4 is 16, and 16 minus 11 is 5. It works.
So here is the plan for any equation like this. First clear away what is added or taken off. Then undo the times. Your turn next!
